overall: The AG found, as the Council conceded, that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by circulating and signing a statement outside a posted meeting; ordered future compliance and closed the complaint.

allegations.summary: Alleged all nine councilors circulated and signed a letter on allegations against a school committee member outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating outside of a posted meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
remedy_passage: We order the Council’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
